text: Cross-dock the design parcel straight into implementation, preserving citations, decision boundaries, and open questions.
rationale: The same artifact travels across handoffs without repacking.

text: Use hub-and-spoke dispatch: the parent routes only each worker’s missing edge, while every spoke returns a self-contained artifact.
rationale: Routing stays centralized without rewriting worker-authored work.

text: Open a returns lane: acceptance defects go directly to the responsible owner with a typed failure reason.
rationale: Failed last-mile deliveries avoid retracing already-cleared stages.

text: Build a last-mile kit at adoption containing implementation steps, source receipts, and acceptance probes.
rationale: The delivery parcel arrives ready for coding and independent verification.

text: Run a milk-run source expedition that collects receipts for every shortlisted design in one bounded route.
rationale: Related source custody travels together while remaining attached to each claim.

text: Reverse-logistics rejected ideas into explicit constraints on the next design brief.
rationale: Dead ends become routing information instead of recurring cargo.
